name: Xi Jinping
position: General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party; President of the People's Republic of China; Chairman of the Central Military Commission
ideology: Communist Party orthodoxy with strong centralisation of power ("Xi Jinping Thought")
period_active: General Secretary since Nov 2012; President since March 2013; term limits on the presidency were removed in 2018
foreign_policy_position: Assertive regional posture (Taiwan, South China Sea), Belt & Road global infrastructure diplomacy, close alignment with Russia short of formal military alliance, strategic competition with the US.
current_status: In office, holding all three top posts (party, state, military) concurrently, a structural feature of the current Chinese system.
